package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_serialization_gzip_writer_created_per_small_payload: Layer: Serialization and deserialization. Flag gzip writers created for tiny payloads where compression overhead can dominate.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario590Positive(payloads [][]byte) ([][]byte, error) {
	var results [][]byte
	for i, p := range payloads {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		w := gzip.NewWriter(&buf)
		if _, err := w.Write(p); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("gzip write at %d: %w", i, err)
		}
		if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("gzip close at %d: %w", i, err)
		}
		results = append(results, buf.Bytes())
	}
	return results, nil
}
